Kiwi integration for 5golgyeo_word — 2026-09-12

Kiwi: Copyright (c) 2017 Minchul Lee and contributors.
Official source: https://github.com/bab2min/Kiwi
Version reported by WASM: 0.23.2
Source commit: 38cd9f1c38983e6b05be0b6823826bd1dd5466d4

The upstream LICENSE says LGPL-2.1-or-later. README says LGPL v3;
the maintainer acknowledges this discrepancy in issue #269.
This distribution uses the LGPL v3 option for Kiwi and its binding.
Both LGPL v3 and GPL v3 texts, upstream notice, and LGPL 2.1 text are included.
The proposed Apache relicensing is NOT applied to this version.

Core algorithms, kiwi_wasm.cpp, and TypeScript binding source are unchanged.
Only bindings/wasm/CMakeLists.txt changes the shell quoting of
EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS=FS to permit Windows linking; same exported API.
space() and glue() already exist in this pinned official commit.
The npm 0.23.0 binary was not used.

Our worker and UI integration are separate from upstream/. The worker loads
the model, invokes upstream space(), validates non-whitespace characters,
and protects contiguous notation from inserted spaces. It is not a replacement
spacing algorithm. New integration code may be used under LGPL-3.0-or-later.
This does not change any existing application, CKEditor, or MuPDF license.

Corresponding source and build instructions are supplied separately as
5golgyeo_word_kiwi_source_separate.zip. This runtime archive does not contain them.
The distributor must publish that source package with equivalent free access
and add its actual public download URL here before public distribution.
Recipients can rebuild and replace upstream/build/kiwi-wasm.js,
upstream/kiwi-wasm.wasm and wrapper JS without changing the application.
Do not impose restrictions on modification/replacement or reverse engineering
needed to debug modifications to this library. Preserve license/copyright notices.
If redistributing a modified library, include the modified corresponding source.

Third-party components in the build (see licenses/ and source archive):
cpp-btree: Apache-2.0; nlohmann/json: MIT; streamvbyte: Apache-2.0.
Eigen: primarily MPL-2.0, with separately licensed files; MPL/Apache/BSD/MINPACK notices are preserved.
Unused Eigen GPL/LGPL license duplicates and disabled mimalloc notices are excluded. Emscripten runtime: MIT / UIUC-NCSA; libc/libc++/compiler
runtime notices (including LLVM exceptions and musl notices) are also included.

MODELS ARE NOT INCLUDED IN THIS DISTRIBUTION.
The official v0.23.2 cong/base model is downloaded only on first local recovery.
Exact URLs, sizes and SHA-256 checksums are in model_manifest.json.
The model is cached locally in browser Cache Storage when available.
No selected text is placed in URLs, requests, logs or browser persistent storage
by this Kiwi adapter. Only static official model files are downloaded.
The model has not been relabeled LGPL or Apache by this project.
The maintainer says model terms are separate and follow source-corpus terms:
https://github.com/bab2min/Kiwi/issues/269
Self-hosting/repackaging the model remains deferred until redistribution terms
are clarified. Automatic download is not a claim of unrestricted model licensing.
